name: check
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -5

name: dl-status
cmd: GDP_ENGINE_STATUS=research/protocols/engine/picks/distributed_lock.txt GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only distributed_lock --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/e.log | cut -c1-200; grep -E 'STATUS|join failed|join houdini' /tmp/e.log | cut -c1-3000

name: ring-status
cmd: GDP_ENGINE_STATUS=research/protocols/engine/picks/ring_leader_election.txt GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only ring_leader_election --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/e.log | cut -c1-200; grep -E 'STATUS|join failed|join houdini' /tmp/e.log | cut -c1-3000
